Zapier. Out: with `ZAPIER_HOOK_URL` set, Mandate posts an `AutomationEvent` to that Catch Hook for
every approval request, blocked purchase, payment, failed payment and mandate status change.
In: a Zap can pull the kill switch with `AUTOMATION_SECRET`. Automations can stop spending, never approve it.
Pause, resume or revoke spending from an automation\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>
For a Zap such as \"text STOP to pause every agent\". Without `mandateId` it acts on all of the\nuser's mandates. Logged in the signed decision log as \"via automation\".\n
The buyer side of the demo. Single demo user, no login.
Server status and which services are live or simulated\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>

Which integrations this server is running with: real PayPal sandbox or simulated payments, the
model behind the agent, where data is stored, and whether Zapier alerts and the kill switch are on.
Always sandbox-only.
The demo user's mandates\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Every mandate the demo user has signed, with its rules and status (active, paused or revoked).
Sign spending rules\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>

With only `text`, the rules reader (the configured model, or the offline reader) turns the
sentence into a policy and Mandate signs it. With `policy`, the rules the user reviewed are
validated and signed. Rate limited when the model is called.
Let the shopping agent carry out a task under a mandate\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>
The agent can only search, read and propose. Each proposal goes through the policy gate, which\npays, asks the user, or blocks. With `stream: true` the response is NDJSON, one step per line.\n
Purchases waiting for the user\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Purchases the gate sent to the user (over a soft limit), with when each request expires.
Approve or decline a purchase\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>

If the user has a passkey, approving needs a WebAuthn assertion over this exact cart
(challenge from `GET /api/approvals/{id}/passkey`). Hard rules (category, seller, injected
instructions) can never be approved through.
Check an agent payment before you ship, or for a dispute. Public keys only, no trust in Mandate needed.
Verdict for an agent payment\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>

Is this PayPal order backed by a mandate the buyer signed? Returns the Mandate v1 checks
(Intent, Cart and Payment Mandates, Ed25519), the `paypal_order_record` check (PayPal's own
order record, read with the PayPal Server SDK, shows the signed amount captured), and the
AP2 v0.2 verdict in `ap2`.
Fulfil only when `ok` and `ap2.ok` are both true.
AP2 v0.2 evidence pack for a PayPal order\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>

The merchant-signed checkout JWT, the Checkout and Payment Mandate chains (SD-JWT, ES256),
the checkout and payment receipts, budget context, the passkey assertion if the buyer approved
on their device, and every check with its result. Verify independently with `/api/ap2/jwks`.
A merchant's agent payments with their verdicts\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Every agent payment to a merchant, newest first, each with its Mandate v1 verdict and AP2 v0.2\nresult. A seller's queue of \"safe to fulfil\" and \"don't ship\" orders.\n
Verify a Mandate v1 credential chain you hold\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>
Checks an Intent, Cart and Payment Mandate chain against the published keys.
Public keys for everything Mandate signs.
ES256 public keys (JWKS) for every AP2 credential\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Provider, agent, payment gateway, merchants and users. Look keys up by `kid`.
All public keys, Mandate v1 (Ed25519 PEM) and AP2 v0.2 (JWKS)\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
The full trust bundle in one call: users' and merchants' Ed25519 keys (with each merchant's\nverified status), the platform key, and the AP2 JWKS. Cache it to verify payments offline.\n
Ed25519 public key that signs receipts and permits\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
The PEM public key for checking the `signature` on every receipt in the decision log.
The signed, hash-chained decision log\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Every decision Mandate made, in order. Each receipt carries the hash of the one before it and an\nEd25519 signature, so any edit, insertion or deletion breaks the chain.\n
Verify the server's own log\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Re-checks every hash link and signature in the server's decision log.
Verify a copy of the log you hold\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>
